units.source_text: 相思之情比往日更深矣！”

en.t: My longing for you has grown even deeper than before!"

units.source_text: 这信写在白纸上，封成立文式。

en.t: This letter was written on white paper and folded into the formal tatebumi style.

units.source_text: 笔迹虽然不甚工致，但书法确有真实功夫。

en.t: Although the handwriting was not especially elegant, the calligraphy clearly showed real skill.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的信则写得很长，信笺折得很小。

en.t: Prince Niou's letter, by contrast, was very long, and the letter paper had been folded quite small.
Each of the two had its own charm.

units.source_text: 右近等劝道：“趁无人看见之时，先给亲王写回信吧。”

en.t: Ukon and the others urged her, "While no one is watching, write a reply to the prince first."

units.source_text: 浮舟羞答答地说：“今天我不能写回信。”

en.t: Ukifune said shyly, "I cannot write a reply today."
She merely wrote down a poem at hand:
